features.name: Temporal Awareness
features.desc: You add your Intelligence modifier to your Initiative.

features.name: Chronal Shift
features.desc: As a Reaction (twice per Long Rest), you force a creature within 30 feet to reroll an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw it just made.

features.name: Momentary Stasis
features.desc: As an action (Con saving throw), you put a creature within 30 feet into stasis: it is Incapacitated and can't move until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Arcane Abeyance
features.desc: You store a spell of level 4 or lower in a tiny sphere to cast it later.

features.name: Convergent Future
features.desc: Instead of rolling a d20 (yours or another creature's), you declare a result of 1 or 20, paying for it with Exhaustion.
